name: thimbledb-cloudflare-starter
description: Authenticated notes starter for ThimbleDB, Cloudflare Workers, R2, and Vite.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.example.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
